text:
Alex W: FYI, enterprise customer reported 502s during canary->stable swap; they captured request-id r-2718-03f9 and a curl snippet. Can we collect debug bundle and verify pin behavior?
Maria S: Which request-id? can you paste the header the customer sent?
Alex W: r-2718-03f9
Alex W: They also sent curl: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: r-2718-03f9" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-beta","input":"hello"}'
```
Dan P: tagging @Ingrid L — looks like canary was running model v1.2.3 while stable had v1.2.2. Possible mismatch in routing fallback.
Ingrid L: ok grabbing traces — can you confirm customer's org id and whether they had a model pin?
Alex W: org 777-acme. They say they pinned to `redwood-small@v1.2.2` but canary routing might have sent `redwood-small@v1.2.3` during rollout.
Dan P: Please ask for the full debug bundle (logs + server traces). Send them: `support-collect --req r-2718-03f9 --include-logs --curl` and our debug-collector will generate a bundle.
Maria S: also ask them to run an authenticated curl that reproduces the 502 and include `-H "X-Request-ID: <same>"` so our traces line up.
Alex W: I'll send the template.
Support Bot: ticket #SUP-18291 created and linked to canary-rollout-inv https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-18291 :thumbsup:
Ops Bot: snapshot taken s3://redwood-debug/777-acme/r-2718-03f9.tgz
Ingrid L: I'm seeing the proxy returned 502 at 12:32:04 UTC with upstream error EPIPE to runtime pod. Attaching stack snippets: 
```
runtime: kvcache miss -> load model shard
kernel: cudnn_conv_forward failed - ENOMEM
```
Dan P: ENOMEM suggests quantization/profile mismatch — could occur if canary compiled kernels differently. We need the model artifact checksums.
Maria S: ask customer to run `sha256sum model.bin` from their pinned artifact or we can pull our artifact if they allow.
Alex W: customer okayed pulling artifacts. Dan, Ingrid — can you try to replay via canary runtime with their request-id and see if fallback to stable triggers?
Ingrid L: will run a local replay, will report back in ~20m.
Dan P: If replay hits the same ENOMEM we should temporarily disable canary for that org and force stable pin as workaround.
Alex W: Agreed. I'll coordinate the rollback change list and notify CS.
Maria S: Thanks team, keeping customer updated. :pray:
